member.name: T:AWSSignatureGenerator.AwsChunkedStreamReader
member.summary:
Reads an aws-chunked encoded stream and yields individual chunks with their signatures.
Wire format:
<hex-size>;chunk-signature=<signature>
 <chunk-data>
 ... 0;chunk-signature=<signature>
 
 [optional trailing headers]
 
 0;chunk-signature=<trailer-signature>

member.name: M:AWSSignatureGenerator.AwsChunkedStreamReader.#ctor(System.IO.Stream)
member.param: Input stream containing aws-chunked encoded data.

member.name: M:AWSSignatureGenerator.AwsChunkedStreamReader.ReadNextChunkAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Read the next chunk from the stream. After the final data chunk is returned (IsFinal = true), call again to read trailing headers and trailer signature if present. Returns null when there is nothing left to read.
member.returns: Chunk result with data, signature, and whether this is the final chunk, or null if stream is exhausted.

member.summary: Compute the expected signature for the next chunk. Call this for each chunk in order, including the final zero-length chunk. This advances internal state (the previous signature is updated).
